text: A spacer-tech revolver for that frontier feel with high-tech power. A coil-array accelerates single shots capable of popping the heads of multiple ne'er do wells in a neat line.\n\nJust like its conventional counterpart, this gun supposedly is capable of incredibly lucky shots.

A spacer-tech gauss rifle themed as a steamworld-inspired repeater. A set of coils accelerate terromagnetic sabots capable of penetrating multiple layers of flesh and armor.\n\nJust like its conventional counterpart, this gun supposedly is capable of incredibly lucky shots.
